notes: One row per concept-vs-control comparison (some versions split: gen2 direct/generator; rank-2 offline/LLM; Luna retest v23/v24; v53 Stage 1/2). registered_verdict is normalized to {GO, NO-GO, no signal, rule met (weak), ceiling, invalid}; the exact wording is in verdict_text and the decision basis in 'registration' (primary/secondary/exploratory/report-only). 'rule not met' and 'not promising' map to NO-GO except where every arm saturates (ceiling). Early (v3m2..v11) rows had sign-test primaries, not GO rules: a significant primary is 'rule met (weak)'. P-fb has null verdict (report-only). arms: concept = primary concept arm; plain/placebo/random = the matched control named in metric; hybrid arms map concept-hybrid/plain-hybrid/placebo-hybrid. model_tier: weak = Qwen family (7B, 1.5B, 32B, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B); strong = Codex/Luna/Sol/Sonnet/Gemini 2.5 Flash (Gemini is not in the coordinator's list; classed strong as a non-Qwen hosted model); none = CPU-only selection/ceiling.
